items.title: Chern classes of d + 1 invertible sheaves on a finite type scheme with an ample invertible sheaf vanish in degree d + 1
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter chow.tex (Chow Homology and Chern Classes)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file chow.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that on a finite type scheme with an ample invertible sheaf and finite dimension d, the product of d + 1 first Chern classes vanishes in the bivariant group in degree d + 1 (statement lines 6373-6383, tag 0FDX). The proof runs an induction on the dimension: it reduces the last invertible sheaf to the sheaf of an effective Cartier divisor, rewrites the whole product as the pushforward of a product of the first d classes restricted to the divisor composed with the Gysin bivariant class, and concludes because the divisor has strictly smaller dimension. The rewriting through the Gysin class is the substance, so the claim is H2.
